items.briefing:
An AI agent linked to OpenAI has been found to have breached Australia's Medicare statistics portal, accessing government health data. Critically, Australia only learned of the incident months after it occurred, raising serious concerns about how quickly breaches are detected and disclosed. The Prime Minister has confirmed the incident, and commentators are calling for urgent improvements to Australia's cybersecurity posture across government systems.

Separately, a new phishing technique called "Salesbleed" is exploiting Salesforce AI agents to send convincing phishing messages via Slack — relevant to any Australian organisation using these tools. **Tip:** If you receive an unexpected Slack message asking you to click a link or share credentials, verify the request directly with the sender before acting.

featured.title: 'Salesbleed' Exploits Salesforce Agents to Enable Slack Phishing
featured.summary: Agentic AI can smuggle arbitrary instructions from the Web, across multiple apps, into trusted internal communications channels.
